name: Boku no Satori: Natsu no Yousei Hen
original_name: 僕の悟リ 夏の妖精編
source:
One summer vacation day I met a pixie-like girl. 
In the blink of an eye my heart belonged to her, and she awakened my sexuality. 
From river to island to lake to sandy shore, ours is a wet summer of discovery.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE178941.html]DLsite English[/url]]
